title: Smoked Pork Skewers with American BBQ Glaze
description: A delicious and easy-to-make dish featuring smoked pork, perfect for a summer barbecue. The American BBQ glaze adds a sweet and tangy flavor to the dish.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, brown sugar, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the pork cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the bacon pieces with a little bit of oil and place on the grill.
Grill the bacon for 2-3 minutes per side, or until crispy.
Add the skewers to the grill and cook for 5-7 minutes per side, or until the pork is cooked through.
While the skewers are cooking, brush the American BBQ sauce onto the pork.
Once the pork is cooked, remove from the grill and top with crispy bacon, chopped cilantro, and sliced American cheese.
